title: Leo config.json
description: Optional settings file: ~/.claude/leo/config.json (or $LEO_HOME/config.json). Every key is optional. `leo doctor` validates this file.

lang.description: Language of Leo's messages and of the Haiku prompt. Empty: LEO_LANG, then the system locale, then en.

profile.description: 'director' is the author's personal vocabulary (Russian only).

mode.description: block: a serious finding sends the answer back for a fix (one round). advice: only a hint, never blocks.

minLength.description: Answers at least this long (characters) are checked even without claim words. Answers under 120 characters are never checked.

model.description: Model for the check, passed to `claude --model`.

maxCostPerDay.description: Daily limit in dollars for checks; 0 means no limit.

reader.description: Plain words, short, clear what to do.

skeptic.description: Unverified claims, forgotten promises, broken rules.

ruleTtlDays.description: How many days a rule recorded with `rule add` stays active.

triggers.description: Extra claim words that make a 120+ character answer worth checking.

autoCollect.description: Collect session state from the transcript before compaction.

memoryIndex.description: Path to a memory index markdown file (optional).
